### [JustMC](https://justwiki.gitbook.io/wiki)
Our server is famous for our unique modes and minigames for everyone: classic **BedWars**, chaotic **LuckyWars**, **Creative+** with plenty of games and ability to create your own, as well as survival in industrial **SkyBlock** without mods
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ebb3ab2d22860b975e615e2f7dac0f1ba7400df.png)
### [Creative+](https://justwiki.gitbook.io/wiki/creative/about)
Creative mode, where each player can create their own minigame through intuitive code or play hundreds of other games created by the community
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ebb3ab2d22860b975e615e2f7dac0f1ba7400df.png)
### [SkyBlockM](https://justwiki.gitbook.io/wiki/skyblockm/about)
Industrial version of usual SkyBlock with unique features. Does not require any mods to play
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ebb3ab2d22860b975e615e2f7dac0f1ba7400df.png)
